newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-SKIPPER LAUDRUP RETURNS FOR SLOVENIA MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SKIPPER LAUDRUP RETURNS FOR SLOVENIA MATCH.

text.p: Captain Michael Laudrup returns to Denmark's 18-man squad for a World Cup European group one qualifier against Slovenia in Copenhagen on April 30.
Midfielder Laudrup, who plays for Japan's Vissel Kobe, pulled out of Denmark's last qualifier against Croatia in Split last month citing lack of training but is now fit to rejoin the team.
He will play with his striker brother Brian of Glasgow Rangers, who scored Denmark's sole goal in their lucky 1-1 away draw with the Croats last month.
There are no newcomers in the squad but midfielder Jon Dahl Tomasson of Dutch team Heerenveen is to be given the chance of a second international cap after making his debut against Croatia.
Lyngby striker Miklos Molnar, top scorer in Denmark's Superleague with 20 goals to his credit this season, rejoins the team.
Goalkeepers: Peter Schmeichel (Manchester United), Mogens Krogh (Brondby)
Defenders: Jacob Laursen (Derby), Marc Rieper (West Ham), Jes Hoegh (Fenerbahce), Jan Heintze (Bayer Leverkusen), Thomas Helveg (Udinese).

Midfielders: Michael Schjoenberg (Kaiserslautern), Per Frandsen (Bolton Wanderers), Michael Laudrup (Vissel Kobe), Allan Nielsen (Tottenham Hotspur), Brian Steen Nielsen (Odense),Claus Thomsen (Everton), Jon Dahl Tomasson (Heerenveen).
Strikers: Mikkel Beck (Middlesbrough), Brian Laudrup (Glasgow Rangers), Miklos Molnar (Lyngby), Per Pedersen (Blackburn Rovers).
